title: Student Side View Options
description: Configure which tabs are visible, their order, and which one opens by default in the student side view.

resendMessage.label: Allow resending a message
resendMessage.hint: Adds a Resend button to each sent message in the Notifications tab. Resending delivers the message to the learner again.

defaultTab.label: Default Tab
defaultTab.hint: The tab that opens when the side view is first shown.
